jobs.title: Senior Specialist, Technical Product Management
jobs.description:
Job Description
  
  

Senior Specialist, Technical Product Management, CRM
  
  

The Opportunity
  
Join a global biopharma company with a 130\-year legacy and mission to achieve new milestones in healthcare. Be part of technology driven, data\-led organization supporting a diversified portfolio of medicines, vaccines and animal health products. Work alongside passionate teams that use data, analytics and insights to drive decisions, and tackle some of the world’s greatest health threats.
  
  

Our Technology Centers are globally distributed hubs that enable our digital transformation and business outcomes across IT. They bring together diverse teams to collaborate, share best practices, and deliver solutions that save and improve lives.
  
  

This role is based at our Hyderabad Tech Center and follows a hybrid working model (3 days onsite, 2 days remote). Candidates are expected to reside within commuting distance of the Hyderabad office.
  
  

Role Overview
  
As a Technical Product Manager, you will own and manage the product throughout its lifecycle, ensuring it delivers business value, supports user needs, and aligns with strategic priorities. You will partner with business stakeholders, technical SMEs, and delivery teams to define product vision, prioritize the backlog, and guide delivery of technical solutions. This role requires a balance of strategic thinking and technical understanding.
  
What will you do in this role
  
  

* Own and manage the product across its full lifecycle, ensuring alignment to business needs, user experience, and strategic outcomes.
* Define and evolve the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and priorities to maximize value delivery and long\-term sustainability.
* Lead discovery and requirement definition activities.
* Create, maintain, and prioritize the product backlog, ensuring alignment to agreed priorities.
* Review requirements, change requests, and proposed solutions to ensure alignment with business objectives, technical feasibility, and regulatory needs.
* Drives delivery of product enhancements and releases through the agreed delivery and change management process.
* Monitor product performance, adoption, feedback, and key metrics.
* Identify risks, issues, dependencies, and impacts, and define mitigation actions to support successful delivery.
* Provide overall leadership, guidance, and management of all aspects of a given solution, including requirements gathering, enhancements delivery plan and implementation.
* Partner with business stakeholders, technical SMEs, solution architects, and development teams to translate needs into clear product solutions.
* Facilitate communication and coordination across delivery squads, stakeholders, and senior management.
* Evaluate Veeva CRM solutions that meet business needs with minimal customization, recommending standard Veeva features whenever possible.
* Stay current on new technologies, methodologies, industry practices, standards, and the Veeva CRM roadmap.
* Apply AI tools to improve daily work processes and productivity.


What Should you have
  
Educational requirement is mandatory. The years of experience forR3 is fixed to 7\-11 years,do not alter. Skills are separated intoPrimary and Secondary – this structure must be maintained to support HiredScore screening.
  
* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science or any Technology stream.
* 7\-11 years of experience in technical product management, service delivery and other related IT positions.


Primary skills (must\-have)
  
* Solid knowledge of SDLC processes, including requirements, design, implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to diverse audiences.
* Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a customer\-focused environment.
* Proven background in strategic planning.
* Demonstrated ability in stakeholder management and cross\-functional collaboration.
* Strong understanding of technical and business processes impacts to support informed decision\-making.
* Familiarity with product management and agile methodologies.
* Proven ability to lead technical squads and coordinate end\-to\-end delivery.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and lead complex technical initiatives.


Secondary skills (nice to have)
  
* Exposure to larger\-scale transformation or enterprise delivery
* Familiarity with product metrics, adoption, and performance monitoring
* Solid technical background beyond product management
* Exposure to regulated or highly governed environments
* Knowledge of CRM tools, preferably Veeva CRM


What we look for
  
Imagine getting up in the morning for a job as important as helping to save and improve lives around the world. Here, you have that opportunity. You can put your empathy, creativity, digital mastery, or scientific genius to work in collaboration with a diverse group of colleagues who pursue and bring hope to countless people who are battling some of the most challenging diseases of our time. Our team is constantly evolving, so if you are among the intellectually curious, join us—and start making your impact today.
  
  

**Required Skills:**  

Asset Management, Asset Management, Backlog Management, Backlog Prioritization, Benefits Management, Business Alignment, Business Decisions, Business Metrics, Business Needs, Customer Centricity, Delivery Management, Life Cycle Planning, Management System Development, Product Delivery, Product Management, Product Ownership, Product Roadmap, Requirements Management, Solutions Development, Stakeholder Management, Stakeholder Relationship Management, Strategic Alignment, Strategic Objectives, Strategic Planning, System Designs {\+ 1 more}

jobs.title: Senior Staff Product Manager - Data Protection
jobs.description:
**Our Company** 
  

  

 At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.
   

  

**What You’ll Do** 
  

  

 In this role, you will serve as a product leader driving Teradata’s data protection product management strategy and execution across our global portfolio. You will define and influence how Teradata delivers resilient data protection for the world’s most sensitive enterprise data; spanning backup and recovery, replication, disaster recovery, business continuity, and cyber resilience.
   

  

 Your impact will be shaping how customers meet aggressive RTO and RPO targets at Petabyte scale ensuring reliable backup, rapid recovery, and continuous data availability across hybrid and multi\-cloud environments. You will accelerate the delivery of the Enterprise data protection and resilience roadmap, balancing innovation with performance, reliability, and compliance.
   

  

 Success in this role will be measured by delivering enterprise\-grade data protection and resilience solutions for hybrid and multi\-cloud deployments, differentiating Teradata and unlocking measurable customer value while preserving scalability, reliability, and cost\-efficiency.
   

  

**Who You Will Work With**
 On our team, we collaborate with customers, engineering, cloud infrastructure, security operations, governance, field teams, and UX functions to bring next\-generation data protection and resilience capabilities into Teradata’s enterprise ecosystem. We are responsible for the product vision, roadmap, and execution of backup, recovery, and resilience initiatives, ensuring they meet both business and technical objectives.
   

  

**What Makes You a Qualified Candidate**
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, engineering, or related field.
* 12\+ years of product management experience, including 6\+ years leading data protection, backup and recovery, or disaster recovery products at enterprise scale, including Managed Service Providers
* Deep technical expertise across the data protection stack: backup software and storage platforms, deduplication and compression, snapshot management, replication topologies, immutable and air\-gapped storage, ransomware recovery, DR orchestration, and RPO/RTO optimization across on\-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments.
* Proven success embedding backup, recovery, and resilience capabilities into enterprise data platforms at petabyte scale, with measurable improvements to customer SLA attainment and recovery confidence.
* Demonstrated knowledge of hybrid and multi\-cloud architectures and their impact on backup strategy, data residency, sovereignty, storage tiering, and cost optimization.
* Exceptional communication skills with the ability to articulate data protection product strategy to both technical and executive audiences.
* Track record of customer engagement, market analysis, and competitive benchmarking against leading backup and data protection vendors and native cloud provider capabilities.


**What You Will Bring**
* Expertise architecting enterprise backup topologies, cyber resiliency and Agentic AI data protection strategies across on\-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments, with a focus on minimizing recovery time
* Hands\-on knowledge of leading backup and recovery platforms (e. g. , Rubrik, Veeam, Cohesity, Commvault, Zerto, NetBackup) and cloud\-native backup services (AWS Backup, Azure Backup, Google Cloud Backup and DR).
* Ability to connect backup and recovery strategy to modern AI/ML and analytics workloads, including protecting training datasets, model checkpoints, feature stores, and data pipelines against corruption, accidental deletion, and ransomware.
* A strong understanding of backup retention policy design, covering lifecycle management, legal hold, eDiscovery readiness, and compliance\-driven retention schedules for regulated data classes (PII, PHI, PCI) across tiered and archival storage.
* Vision to anticipate industry trends, next\-generation backup architectures, AI\-driven anomaly detection for data corruption, and data sovereignty mandates and position Teradata’s data protection offerings as differentiated and enterprise\-ready.


**Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata**
 We prioritize a people\-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well\-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are an anti\-racist company because our dedication to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is more than a statement. It is a deep commitment to doing the work to foster an equitable environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.
   

  

 Teradata invites all identities and backgrounds in the workplace. We work with deliberation and intent to ensure we are cultivating collaboration and inclusivity across our global organization. ​ We are proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, ancestry, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related conditions), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, gender identity or expression, military and veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

**SonicWall** 
  is a cybersecurity forerunner with more than 30 years of expertise and is recognized as a leading partner\-first company, ensuring our partners and their customers are never alone in the fight against cybercrime. With the ability to build, scale and manage security across the cloud, hybrid and traditional environments in real\-time, SonicWall provides relentless security against the most evasive cyberattacks across endless exposure points for increasingly remote, mobile and cloud\-enabled users. With its own threat research center, SonicWall can quickly and economically provide purpose\-built security solutions to enable any organization—enterprise, government agencies and SMBs—around the world. For more information, visit 
 **www.sonicwall.com** 
  or follow us on 
 **Twitter** 
 , 
 **LinkedIn** 
 , 
 **Facebook** 
  and 
 **Instagram** 
 .
 


 About Cloud Secure Edge
 
 Cloud Secure Edge (CSE) is SonicWall’s cloud\-delivered Security Service Edge (SSE) platform, providing enterprise\-grade Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), VPN\-as\-a\-Service, Secure Web Gateway (SWG), and Cloud Access Security Broker (CASB) capabilities. CSE enables organizations to enforce least\-privilege access policies across managed and unmanaged devices, continuously verifying user identity, device posture, and contextual signals before granting access to private applications, SaaS resources, and internet destinations. This is a high\-growth, strategically critical product line at the center of SonicWall’s SASE transformation.
 


 The Role
 
 We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to help shape and drive SonicWall Cloud Secure Edge. In this role, you will serve as the connective tissue between engineering, design, sales, marketing, and customer success—translating market needs and customer insights into product direction. You will operate at the intersection of deep technical understanding and sharp commercial instinct, influencing the platform’s evolution to deliver measurable security outcomes for SonicWall customers and partners.
 


 Key ResponsibilitiesProduct Strategy \& Roadmap
 * Influence and help define the Cloud Secure Edge product vision and strategy; own the execution of the multi\-quarter roadmap aligned with SonicWall’s SASE and Zero Trust go\-to\-market objectives.
* Prioritize features and capabilities based on customer feedback, competitive intelligence, market trends, and engineering feasibility.
* Develop and present business cases for new investments to executive leadership, including TAM analysis, win/loss data, and projected impact on ARR.


 Technical Product Ownership
 * Partner closely with engineering leadership to define requirements, write detailed specifications, and make informed trade\-off decisions on scope, architecture, and delivery timelines.
* Drive integration strategy across SonicWall’s security portfolio, including firewalls, endpoint agents, and threat intelligence services.
* Ensure extensibility for MSP automation workflows and third\-party integrations (SIEM, SOAR, IdP).
* Evaluate and influence platform architecture decisions related to multi\-tenancy, scalability, and cloud\-native deployment models.


 Zero Trust \& SASE Domain Leadership
 * Serve as the internal subject matter expert on ZTNA, SSE, and SASE frameworks, educating cross\-functional teams and informing competitive positioning.
* Monitor and analyze the competitive landscape (Zscaler, Palo Alto Prisma, Cloudflare, Netskope) to identify differentiation opportunities and parity gaps.
* Translate regulatory and compliance trends (NIST Zero Trust Architecture, CISA guidelines) into actionable product requirements.


 Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Go\-to\-Market
 * Collaborate with Product Marketing to develop positioning, messaging, competitive battle cards, and sales enablement content.
* Work directly with strategic customers and MSP partners to validate product direction, conduct design\-partner programs, and gather feedback.
* Support sales engineering teams with technical deep\-dives, RFP responses, and proof\-of\-concept engagements.
* Define and track product success metrics including adoption, activation, retention, NPS, and ARR contribution.


 Required Qualifications
 * 5\+ years of product management experience, with at least 3 years focused on network security, cloud security, or identity/access management products.
* Deep working knowledge of ZTNA, SASE, SSE, SWG, CASB, and/or VPN technologies and their underlying architectures.
* Proven track record of shipping cloud\-native or SaaS products at scale, with experience managing multi\-tenant platforms.
* Strong technical fluency: ability to engage with engineering teams on API design, microservices architecture, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Experience working with channel and MSP partner ecosystems in the cybersecurity space.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting to C\-level stakeholders..


 Preferred Qualifications
 * Experience at a cybersecurity vendor in the SASE or SSE market (e.g., Zscaler, Palo Alto Networks, Cloudflare, Netskope, Fortinet).
* Familiarity with identity providers (Okta, Azure AD, Ping) and their integration patterns with ZTNA platforms.
* Industry certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, or relevant cloud/security credentials.
* Experience with agile product development methodologies and tools (Jira, Aha!, Productboard).
* Background in data\-driven product management with proficiency in analytics platforms (Amplitude, Mixpanel, Pendo).
* AI fluency and demonstrated ability to prototype with AI tools: comfortable leveraging LLMs, copilots, and generative AI to accelerate research, ideation, spec writing, and rapid prototyping of product concepts.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. MBA or advanced degree is a plus.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About the Role** 




 We are looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager to own and evolve our marketing technology and email lifecycle platform. This role sits at the intersection of product strategy, marketing operations, and data privacy driving the roadmap for our Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) ecosystem, email campaign platforms, and consent/preference management (including OneTrust Preference Center) while contributing to broader digital marketing initiatives. The ideal candidate combines strong product management fundamentals with hands\-on technical fluency in SFMC, email marketing best practices, and privacy\-compliant customer communication frameworks.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own the end\-to\-end product roadmap for the email marketing and marketing automation platform (SFMC), aligning with business goals and customer engagement strategy.
* Partner with marketing, CRM, legal, and compliance teams to design and manage subscription and consent workflows using OneTrust Preference Center.
* Define and prioritize product requirements (PRDs/user stories) for email journeys, automation workflows, and personalization capabilities within SFMC.
* Collaborate with engineering and MarTech teams to integrate SFMC, OneTrust, and other digital marketing tools into a unified customer data and communication ecosystem.
* Drive consent management and preference center enhancements to ensure compliance with GDPR, CCPA, CAN\-SPAM, and other global privacy regulations.
* Analyze campaign performance, deliverability metrics, and subscriber preference data to identify opportunities for optimization.
* Lead cross\-functional stakeholder alignment across Marketing, Legal, Data Privacy, Engineering, and Customer Experience teams.
* Define KPIs and success metrics for email engagement, list health, opt\-in/opt\-out rates, and preference center adoption.
* Support broader digital marketing initiatives including campaign personalization, audience segmentation, and channel orchestration.
* Manage the product backlog, sprint planning, and release cycles in an Agile/Scrum environment.
* Stay current with SFMC platform updates, OneTrust feature releases, and evolving data privacy regulations to proactively adapt the roadmap.
* Create documentation, training materials, and enablement content for internal stakeholders on platform capabilities.



**Primary Skills (Must\-Have)** 



* **Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC):** 
 Deep hands\-on experience with Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Email Studio, Contact Builder, and Content Builder.
* **OneTrust Preference Center:** 
 Proven experience configuring, managing, or integrating OneTrust Preference Center for subscription management, consent capture, and privacy compliance workflows.
* **Email Campaign Management:** 
 Strong background in designing, executing, and optimizing email marketing campaigns, including segmentation, personalization, A/B testing, and automated journeys.
* **Product Management Fundamentals:** 
 Solid grounding in Agile/Scrum methodologies, product roadmapping, backlog management, and writing clear PRDs/user stories.
* **Requirement Gathering \& Documentation:** 
 Ability to translate business and compliance needs into detailed technical and functional requirements.
* **Data\-Driven Decision Making:** 
 Experience analyzing campaign and platform metrics (open rates, CTR, deliverability, opt\-in/opt\-out trends) to inform product decisions.

jobs.title: Director, Product Management AI Quality & Evaluation
jobs.description:
FactSet creates flexible, open data and software solutions for over 200,000 investment professionals worldwide, providing instant access to financial data and analytics that investors use to make crucial decisions.
   

  

 At FactSet, our values are the foundation of everything we do. They express how we act and operate, serve as a compass in our decision\-making, and play a big role in how we treat each other, our clients, and our communities. We believe that the best ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time, and that curiosity is the key to anticipating our clients’ needs and exceeding their expectations.
   

  

 We ship AI into workflows where being confidently wrong is expensive. A banker builds a pitchbook from generated tombstones and charts. A portfolio manager acts on AI\-generated attribution commentary, and an analyst asks a conversational assistant a question and gets back an answer synthesized across filings, transcripts, estimates, news, and their own firm's internal data. In each case the output looks finished, and it carries FactSet's name into work a client will act on.
   

  

 When AI gets something wrong in these workflows, the cost is contractual and reputational, and in some cases regulatory. The error does not stay inside our product. It travels into a client's own work product and into the decisions they make from it.
   

  

 AI has moved from a feature inside a few products to a capability across the platform, and our quality practice needs to scale with it. Teams have built their own test sets and their own working definitions of good, which is how most organizations start. At platform scale, conversational assistance, banker workflows, portfolio commentary, research management, and the APIs clients build on top of each need their own measures of quality, evaluated on shared tooling so the results can be compared and audited in one place.
   

  

 This role exists to build that function. You will define the quality and evals playbook for AI at FactSet, own the platform that measures it, and make it straightforward for every team to prove the quality of what they build. You are the first product hire into this charter, and you will build the team behind it.
   

  

**What You Will Own**
**Own the evaluation platform.** 
 You are the product leader for FactSet's shared AI evaluation platform, paired with an engineering counterpart who owns the technical build and operation. Together you stand it up and run it as enterprise infrastructure: tracing, offline and online eval harnesses, LLM\-as\-judge pipelines with calibrated human review, golden dataset management, and regression suites wired into CI. You own the roadmap, the adoption strategy, the integration surface into product teams' existing workflows, and the commercial and roadmap relationship with the platform vendor. Your engineering counterpart owns the technical relationship. You will know it worked when your colleagues across the enterprise run their own evals on it without your team in the loop.
   

  

**Define the golden pathways.** 
 With your engineering counterpart, develop and maintain the golden pathways for evaluation across the enterprise: the documented, opinionated way a team instruments a system, builds a dataset, runs an eval, and wires it into their release process. A product team should be able to follow the paved path without designing an evaluation approach from scratch, and you own keeping those pathways current as practice and tooling change.
   

  

**Define how quality is measured.** 
 Define the quality taxonomy for AI systems across the portfolio: what a failure is, how failures are classified, and which failure classes are non\-negotiable, plus the further classes you define with product leadership and with the PMs who own each capability. This becomes the shared language the organization uses to argue about quality, and you are its steward.
   

  

**Own human review operations.** 
 Evaluation at scale depends on people producing labels on a schedule: judge calibration sets, ground\-truth datasets, and adjudication of disagreements. You own that operation, including how reviewers are sourced, trained, and measured for consistency, what it costs, and how it scales as coverage grows. Your engineering counterpart builds the tooling those reviewers work in.
   

  

**Set and hold the floor.** 
 You define the minimum every AI capability must satisfy before it reaches a client. The floor is a coverage requirement: a capability ships with evals defined and running, tracing in place, a documented failure taxonomy, and a measured baseline it can be held against later. Product teams set their own quality targets above that line and are expected to aim well above it.
   

  

**Drive adoption.** 
 Enterprise platform mandates fail when the platform is slower than the spreadsheet it replaces. You will land this team by team: understand what each product group does for quality today, help them move onto shared tooling and pathways, and make the shared path the easier one. This is a sustained internal go\-to\-market effort and a core part of the job.
   

  

**Close the loop from production.** 
 Design the path from a client\-reported failure to a permanent regression test. The program succeeds when the same failure cannot ship twice. That matters far more than the number of evals in existence.
   

  

**Unite the practice.** 
 Bring evaluation leaders at FactSet together into a small group of PMs and specialists operating as a federated center of excellence. You own the standard and the platform, and product teams own their own quality outcomes against it.
   

  

**What We Are Looking For**
* 10\+ years in product management, with 4\+ years on AI/ML or data\-intensive products, and experience managing product managers
* Demonstrated experience defining evaluation methodology for LLM or ML systems: metrics, failure taxonomies, golden datasets, and quality thresholds t…

We constantly innovate our platform and capabilities to meet tomorrow’s challenges, anticipate the risks our clients encounter, and design advanced solutions to help our clients achieve transformational business outcomes.
   

  

 Financial technology is a high\-growth industry as change and innovation continue to disrupt the status\-quo and prompt major transformation. Arcesium is at a particularly interesting time in our own growth as we look to leverage our successfully established market position and expand operations in pursuit of strategic new business opportunities. We value intellectual curiosity, proactive ownership, and collaboration with colleagues, and we empower you to meaningfully contribute from day one and accelerate your professional development.
   

  

 We are looking for a qualified Chartered Accountant, early in their career (with 1 to 2 years of post\-qualification experience), to join one of our cross\-functional product teams in our Gurugram/Hyderabad/Bengaluru office as an Individual Contributor. This product team is responsible for the core portfolio and P\&L accounting product offering on our platform. This role offers the opportunity to build strong domain expertise in fund and portfolio accounting for some of the most sophisticated hedge funds in the world, while working closely with engineers, product managers, and client\-facing teams.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Carry the product/feature from concept to creation
* Brainstorm product/feature and its value proposition to our client base
* Distill the vision into documents such as product roadmap and product/feature specification via deep dives into domain, gathering requirements and/or business analysis
* Work closely with the engineers/architects to translate the Product Specification to design, and then to the product itself
* Prepare comprehensive business test cases/beds to aid the engineering process
* Rigorously and continuously evaluate the progress of product/feature\-in\-flight by leveraging the created test cases/beds and ensure compliance to the product/feature specification and the vision
* Track and question risks/assumptions
* Proactively escalate issues and mitigate execution risks


**What You'll Need**
* Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) with 1\-2 years of post\-qualification experience
* Strong foundation in accounting principles, financial statements, and journal entries
* Working knowledge of, or strong aptitude to quickly learn, fund/portfolio accounting concepts such as NAV, P\&L, accruals, and corporate actions.
* Knowledge on fixed income and derivatives will be an added advantage.
* Comfortable working in Excel; exposure to SQL. Python or LLM agentic tools is an added advantage
* High attention to detail and a strong sense of ownership over accuracy and timeliness
* Ability to multitask, prioritize, and manage multiple lines of work under tight deadlines
* Clear verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence to work directly with stakeholders
* A collaborative attitude and willingness to learn from and work closely with cross\-functional Engineering, Product, and Operations teams
* Outstanding academic background and a genuine interest in financial markets and technology


 Arcesium's Personal Data Privacy Notice for Candidates is linked here.

In some cases, you may also be contacted by independent search firms engaged to recruit on our behalf; emails from their employees should always come from their firm's applicable domain. We'll never ask for your banking information or any payment as part of the recruiting process. If something seems off or you're contacted by an unexpected third party, please reach out to us at careers@arcesium.com (US/UK), careers\-india@arcesium.com (India) or careers\-europe@arcesium.com (Portugal/Sweden).

Responsibilities:

Primary

* 'Own the multi\-year SAP upgrade roadmap across all PepsiCo platforms, markets and regions
* Prioritize upgrade initiatives based on risk, business value, innovation, and SAP support deadlines
* Identify and resolve cross\-program dependencies and conflicts before execution begins
* Align with SAP/vendor roadmaps, licensing changes, and product lifecycle milestone
* Develop AOP plans including funding, resources, environments, and governance approvals

Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.

* Convert HIPAA gap analyses, NIST 800\-53 privacy controls, and audit findings into scoped Azure DevOps Features/Stories/Tasks with defined acceptance criteria, effort estimates, and an assigned owner
* Keep the backlog organized across active compliance features, covering access control, data classification, log scrubbing, audit logging, data retention \& deletion, and data access restrictions

* 6\-15 years of overall IT experience
* Background in security/privacy compliance, GRC, or compliance engineering, supporting HIPAA and/or FedRAMP/NIST 800\-53 programs
* Understanding of HIPAA Security \& Privacy Rules, including administrative/physical/technical safeguards, BAAs, breach notification, and minimum necessary standards, along with NIST 800\-53 control families such as AC, AU, SI, and PM
* Proven ability to translate compliance/regulatory language into scoped, estimable engineering backlog items using Azure DevOps, Jira, or similar tools
* Hands\-on experience supporting third\-party audits such as SOC 2, FedRAMP, or HITRUST, including evidence collection, control\-to\-evidence mapping, and meeting auditor deadlines
* Knowledge of cloud environments such as AWS GovCloud and/or Azure Government, plus controls including IAM/RBAC, encryption/KMS, audit logging, and data retention \& deletion

* Scripting/automation skills in Python or Bash for automating evidence collection, control testing, or compliance dashboards
* Experience with AWS IAM/identity governance tools such as SailPoint or similar, and access policy management across S3, RDS, DynamoDB, and Redshift
* Awareness of international privacy regimes such as UK/EU GDPR, Australia Privacy Act, or Canada PIPEDA, or willingness to quickly learn as coverage grows
* Relevant certifications: CIPP/US, CIPM, HCISPP, CISA, CISSP, or an AWS/Azure security certification

jobs.description:
At PDI Technologies, we empower some of the world's leading convenience retail and petroleum brands with cutting\-edge technology solutions that drive growth and operational efficiency.
 


  


 By “Connecting Convenience” across the globe, we empower businesses to increase productivity, make more informed decisions, and engage faster with customers through loyalty programs, shopper insights, and unmatched real\-time market intelligence via mobile applications.  We’re a global team committed to excellence, collaboration, and driving real impact. Explore our opportunities and become part of a company that values diversity, integrity, and growth.
 


  






  




**Role Overview:** 
  


 PDI Technologies is looking for a Product Owner to help manage multiple simultaneous projects and issues of varying size, end to end, within our Loyalty engine ecosystem. The Product Owner (PO) is a critical member of an Agile development team that drives the team to deliver high\-quality, high\-value features and functions in service of our Loyalty business.
 


  


 As a PO, you will help shape product features and requirements while working closely with Agile engineering teams, Product Managers, customers, and business stakeholders to build high\-quality products for our target markets. Prior experience in Product Management, Product Owner, or Business Analyst roles — ideally with exposure to loyalty, rewards, or CRM (Customer Relationship Management) platforms — is highly desired.
 


  


 This role is expected to use AI tools and processes as a core part of how work gets done — accelerating requirements\-gathering, documentation, and story breakdown so the team can move faster without sacrificing quality.
 


  


  




**Key Responsibilities:** 
  

  
* **Stay aligned with and contribute to** 
 the Loyalty product vision, roadmap, and priorities
  
* Work closely with Support to understand and prioritize customer\-reported issues within the Loyalty ecosystem
  
* Work closely with system users (customers, partners, consulting) to understand business needs and translate them into actionable user stories
  
* Apply technical astuteness, attention to detail, and proactivity to drive closure and optimize development team throughput
  
* Use AI\-assisted tools and workflows to speed up requirements analysis, documentation, and backlog preparation
  
* Serve as a product evangelist, particularly with Product Managers and Business teams, helping them understand platform best practices
  
* Develop documentation for new Loyalty features, including UI mockups, process flows, and data sequence diagrams
  
* Attend sprint planning meetings and work with the team to define sprint goals
  
* Guide Agile teams in breaking down user stories and defining acceptance criteria
  
* Ensure the product backlog is prioritized and properly balanced between new product work and maintenance
  
* Collaborate with engineering during sprints to review output and answer questions about desired functionality and outcomes
  
* Ensure the team has an appropriately groomed backlog ready for sprint planning; monitor ready stories vs. velocity
  
* Conduct backlog refinement meetings, sprint reviews, and product demos
  
* Manage the product backlog in ALM tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps
  
* Author and publish product release notes and customer notifications
  
* Own release planning for Loyalty initiatives
  

  


  


  




**Qualifications:** 
  

  
* Ability to connect technical system behavior (rules engines, transaction/redemption flows, integrations) with business goals for the Loyalty program
  
* Comfort working within a complex, rules\-driven engine where changes can have wide\-reaching downstream effects
  
* Experience with loyalty, rewards, promotions, or CRM platforms is a strong plus
  
* Fluent with — or genuinely eager to learn — AI\-assisted product workflows (e.g., using AI tools to accelerate PRD drafting, backlog refinement, research synthesis, and documentation) in order to move quickly in a fast\-paced environment
  
* 2–5 years of experience as a Business Analyst, Product Manager, Product Owner, or similar role, including at least 2 years working as an Agile Product Owner
  
* Highly motivated self\-starter with a desire to help others, take action, and seek out resources to excel within the role
  
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts into non\-technical terms and vice versa
  
* Ability to work independently as a contributing member of a high\-paced, focused team, managing multiple priorities and competing deadlines
  
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to work under pressure
  
* Ability to socialize ideas and influence decisions without direct authority
  
* Collaborative by nature, with a strong desire to dig in and learn independently and through asking questions
  
* Comfortable partnering with and reporting to leadership based in the U.S., with strong cross\-time\-zone communication habits
  
* Working knowledge of product and sprint backlog tracking, burn\-down metrics, velocity, and work breakdown techniques
  
* Solid understanding of Agile software development processes and principles
  
* Bachelor’s degree in business, computer science, or equivalent work experience
  

  


  


  




**Preferred Skills:** 
  

  
* Domain experience in Convenience Retail, ERP, Logistics, or Financial transaction processing solutions
  

  


  


  




**Behavioral Competencies:** 
  

  
* Ensures Accountability
  
* Manages Complexity
  
* Communicates Effectively
  
* Balances Stakeholders
  
* Collaborates Effectively

jobs.title: Business Analyst (Healthcare Domain)
jobs.description:
**As a Business Analyst**, you will work across the full product lifecycle, from discovery and concept validation to delivery and post\-launch analysis. You will collaborate closely with product managers, UX designers, data engineers, and QA testers to define requirements, improve workflows, and optimize outcomes. A strong understanding of healthcare\-specific workflows and terminology is essential.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**�� Requirements Gathering \& Product Documentation**

· Elicit and document business, functional, and technical requirements from cross\-functional stakeholders.

· Create detailed **Business Requirement Documents (BRDs)**, **Functional Specifications**, **User Stories**, **Use Cases**, and **Acceptance Criteria**.

· Define complex field\-level rules, interdependencies, and validation logic, especially in modules like:

o Provider Onboarding (NPI, TIN, CLIA, HPSA)

o Patient Intake, Referrals \& Scheduling

o Clinical Documentation \& Case Management

o Eligibility Verification, Claims Intake, Authorizations

· Translate ambiguous business needs into structured product features and user journeys.

**�� Process Mapping \& Analysis**

· Model current and future\-state workflows using BPMN, flow diagrams, and swimlanes.

· Conduct gap analysis between current platform capabilities and future product needs.

· Identify workflow inefficiencies and opportunities for automation or improvement.

· Align product workflows with evolving care models (e.g., virtual care, team\-based care, chronic care management).

**�� Stakeholder Collaboration**

· Act as a liaison between business and technical teams to ensure mutual understanding of product goals.

· Lead requirement walkthroughs and backlog grooming sessions with internal stakeholders.

· Work with clinicians, operations leaders, and compliance officers to ensure regulatory and operational alignment.

· Serve as the “voice of the user” during design, development, and testing phases.

**�� Data \& Integration Analysis**

· Collaborate with data engineering teams to define reporting logic, KPIs, and data validation rules.

· Help define API payload requirements, interface specifications, and system integration points.

· Support FHIR, HL7, and EDI\-based data exchange requirements at a conceptual or field\-level mapping level.

**�� Testing \& Quality Assurance**

· Develop test scenarios, data sets, and expected outcomes based on requirements.

· Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT), identify issues, and validate solutions.

· Help triage production issues by analyzing root causes and clarifying expected behavior.

**Required Qualifications:**

· **8 years of experience** as a Business Analyst in the **healthcare technology or digital health sector**.

· Proven ability to translate healthcare operations into system requirements.

· Strong knowledge of healthcare workflows, such as:

o Provider credentialing or contracting

o Claims, billing, prior authorization

o Clinical documentation workflows

o Patient intake, appointment management, referrals

· Solid understanding of healthcare data structures (e.g., NPI, ICD\-10, CPT, CLIA ID, TIN, HPSA, etc.).

· Proficient in writing detailed, structured user stories with acceptance criteria for Agile/Scrum teams.

· Strong analytical and communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex ideas.

· Hands\-on experience with product collaboration tools: Jira, Confluence, Figma, Lucidchart, or similar.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

· Familiarity with **healthcare interoperability standards** such as FHIR, HL7, or EDI.

· Understanding of privacy and compliance frameworks (e.g., HIPAA, HITECH, GDPR\-equivalent for data protection).

· Exposure to working with EHRs, provider networks, or care coordination platforms.

· Ability to work with relational databases (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL) or tools like Looker/Tableau for validation.

· Experience working in fast\-paced SaaS, product\-led, or startup environments.

jobs.title: Analyst II, Network Strategy and Performance
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


As an Analyst within the Network Strategy Performance team, you will own analytics that directly shape where and how Amazon serves customers globally. You will model network scenarios spanning 100\+ sites across 40\+ countries, inform multi\-year investment decisions, and deliver insights that influence headcount allocation, site strategy, and contact routing for one of the world's largest customer service networks.  

This isn't a reporting role — you'll tackle ambiguous, high\-stakes questions: Where should we expand next? How do we balance cost\-to\-serve against customer experience across geographies? What's the optimal site mix for the next three years? Your analysis will flow directly into monthly, OP and 3YP cycles that leadership uses to allocate resources.  

You will partner closely with Operations, Products, FP\&A, and Service Delivery teams — identifying gaps, measuring performance, and driving automation and process improvement initiatives. You will contribute to the team's AI\-driven transformation agenda by applying AI tools to increase the speed, quality, and scale of analytical outputs.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Own analytical inputs for network planning — model contact allocation scenarios, site investment options, and capacity strategies across geographies. Build and maintain the frameworks that determine how millions of weekly customer contacts are distributed across the global CS network, coordinating with Finance, and Service Delivery teams to ensure alignment with cost and CX targets.
* Translate complex or ambiguous network strategy questions into structured analysis — e.g., site expansion feasibility, cost\-to\-serve trade\-offs, regional performance variance. Dive into the heart of ambiguous problems with non\-defined inputs and outputs, identify root causes driving site or network\-level performance gaps, and derive recommendations that influence headcount allocation, site investment, and network architecture decisions.
* Independently apply AI tools (e.g., Amazon Q, generative AI assistants, AgentZ) to accelerate analytical workflows, identifying opportunities to improve speed and quality of planning outputs. Develop side\-of\-desk automation for repetitive tasks within your workstream, demonstrating measurable productivity improvement.
* Design, implement, and support self\-service analytics platforms that provide business teams with ad\-hoc access to large datasets. Drive automation of data requirements by scaling data processes, creating dashboards, and building efficient queries across diverse data sources (contact volumes, productivity metrics, cost data, CX scores) to provide a holistic view of network performance.
* Communicate complex analytical insights and translate network performance data into clear narratives for Finance, Service delivery and senior leadership. Present analysis to leadership audiences with clarity and conviction. Participate in strategic and tactical planning discussions (OP, 3YP, QXG), producing well\-structured documents that tie conclusions to business outcomes.

  

About the team  

The Network Strategy and Performance (NSP) team defines and delivers the right human\-assisted support to Amazon customers under demand and labor supply volatility, by optimizing the Amazon Customer Service (CS) network for customer experience, associate experience, and cost. We are responsible for: (1\) planning customer support staffing; (2\) preserving the customer experience when customers contact Customer Service; and (3\) ensuring best costs for providing customer support.  

We analyse historical data and anticipate potential business events to accurately predict the number of Customer Service Associates (CSAs) required for a given period. Our areas of expertise span forecasting, planning, optimization, data analytics, execution and reporting. We deliver our vision using operations research, data science, and program management — and we continue to challenge the status quo, invent and simplify, and deliver excellence for our customers.  

The Network Performance team is on a transformation journey. We are building a future\-ready team that combines analytical rigor with AI fluency, executive\-level communication, and the ability to drive outcomes across organizational boundaries. We are seeking an L5 Labor Business Analyst to join this team and help shape how Amazon plans, staff, and optimizes its Customer Service network.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 3\+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* 2\+ years of supply chain experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3\+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* 3\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

**Company Description** 
 INTELLECT INFORMATICS PRIVATE LIMITED is a technology\-driven company based in Telangana, India, with operations in Hyderabad. The organization focuses on delivering IT and business solutions that help clients optimize their processes and improve decision\-making. Team members collaborate closely with stakeholders to understand business challenges and translate them into practical solutions. The company values analytical thinking, clear communication, and a commitment to quality in every project.
 


**Role of a Business Analyst (ERP)** 

**1\. Requirements Gathering and Analysis** 




 The Business Analyst is responsible for understanding business needs and translating them into functional requirements for the ERP product.
 



**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Gather business requirements from multiple stakeholders, including customers, domain experts, regulatory bodies, and product management teams.
* Analyze and validate business requirements to ensure completeness, consistency, and feasibility.
* Identify common business processes that can be standardized across multiple customers.
* Distinguish between core product features and customer\-specific customizations.
* Analyze business pain points and recommend process improvements and automation opportunities.
* Identify and document:
* Master Data requirements
* Transaction Data requirements
* Data Migration requirements
* System Integration requirements
* Business Validation Rules







  





**2\. Product Requirements Documentation** 




 Prepare and maintain comprehensive functional and business documentation throughout the product lifecycle.
 



**Key Deliverables:** 



* Business Requirements Document (BRD)
* Software Requirements Specification (SRS)
* Functional Requirements Specification (FRS)
* Business Process Flows
* Wireframes and Screen Mockups
* Feature Specifications
* Use Cases and User Stories
* Acceptance Criteria
* Functional Gap Analysis
* Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM)







  





**3\. Business Process Analysis and Design** 




 Evaluate current business operations and recommend optimized ERP processes.
 



**Responsibilities:** 



* Study and document existing ("As\-Is") business processes.
* Identify process gaps, bottlenecks, and inefficiencies.
* Design optimized ("To\-Be") business processes aligned with ERP best practices.
* Collaborate with the Product Team to propose process improvements and standardization.







  





**4\. Domain Expertise** 




 Develop and apply domain knowledge to ensure the ERP solution meets industry requirements.
 



**Responsibilities:** 



* Acquire and maintain expertise in the Cooperative domain.
* Understand regulatory, operational, and compliance requirements.
* Provide functional guidance to product and development teams.







  





**5\. Product Backlog Management** 




 Support Agile product development by managing and refining product requirements.
 



**Responsibilities:** 



* Collaborate with Product Managers to create and prioritize Product Backlog Items (PBIs).
* Refine user stories and define clear acceptance criteria.
* Support Sprint Planning, Sprint Reviews, and Release Planning.
* Update and maintain requirements based on stakeholder feedback and changing business needs.
* Track requirement implementation status throughout the development lifecycle.







  





**6\. Cross\-Functional Collaboration** 




 Work closely with cross\-functional teams to ensure successful product delivery.
 



**Collaborate with:** 



* Product Managers
* Solution Architects
* UI/UX Designers
* Developers
* QA Engineers
* Implementation Consultants
* Customer Support Teams
* Business Stakeholders



**Responsibilities:** 



* Clarify business requirements during development.
* Participate in functional discussions and design reviews.
* Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
* Ensure delivered functionality aligns with business requirements.







  





**7\. Documentation and Knowledge Management** 




 Create and maintain documentation to support implementation, training, and product releases.
 



**Key Deliverables:** 



* User Manuals
* Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)
* Release Notes
* Training Materials
* Product Help Documentation
* Functional Knowledge Base
* Version\-wise Documentation Updates



**Key Skills Required** 



* Business Analysis
* ERP Functional Knowledge
* Requirements Gathering and Analysis
* Process Mapping (As\-Is / To\-Be)
* Documentation (BRD, SRS, FRS)
* Agile and Scrum Methodologies
* Product Backlog Management
* Data Analysis
* Communication and Stakeholder Management
* Problem Solving and Critical Thinking
* Domain Knowledge in the Cooperative Sector
* Functional Testing and UAT Support







  





**Expected Outcomes** 



* Accurate and complete business requirements.
* Standardized and optimized business processes.
* High\-quality functional documentation.
* Effective collaboration across teams.
* Well\-managed product backlog.
* Successful ERP feature implementation with minimal rework.
* Improved customer satisfaction through business\-driven solutions.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Axiamatic is the AI\-native control plane for enterprise transformation. Large transformation programs — ERP migrations, CRM rollouts, enterprise\-wide operating model changes — have for decades exceeded what any human team can coordinate. Roughly 70% of these multi\-year, multi\-hundred\-million\-dollar initiatives fall short of expectations. Misalignments and drift build up quietly, and by the time they surface, the cost is already in.
   





 We're changing that. Axiamatic builds a Living Context Graph — a continuously updated digital twin of a customer's transformation, ingesting structured and unstructured signals from 250\+ enterprise systems (SAP, Oracle, Dynamics 365, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Jira, Azure DevOps, Teams, Slack, and more). On top of it, our Transformation Agents detect translation loss, cross\-stream drift, and change resistance as they form, and our Playbooks route remediation to the right stakeholder in the tools they already use.
   





 We came out of stealth in March 2026 with $54M from Greylock and Bessemer. Our founders Rajiv Gupta and Kaushik Narayan have done this before — most recently at Skyhigh Networks (acquired by McAfee), where they defined the Cloud Access Security Broker category that Gartner once named the fastest\-growing in cybersecurity. Rajiv previously co\-founded Confluent Software (Oracle) and Securent (Cisco). Our early customers include the Heico Company and Marmon (a Berkshire Hathaway subsidiary), and we're working with the world's largest systems integrators.
   





 About the role
   





 You'll be one of the early product managers at Axiamatic, owning a major area of our platform end\-to\-end and working with our product and engineering leadership, SMEs and our customers. This is a rare 0→1 \+ scale role: the product is in market with reference customers, the platform is real, and the category is wide open.
   





 You'll define how some of the world's most consequential transformation programs are run — what signals we capture, what risks our agents detect, and how guidance reaches executives, PMOs, and change leaders in the flow of their work.
   

  





 What you'll do
   




* Own a major product area end\-to\-end — strategy, roadmap, execution and enablement.


* Live with our customers and design partners. Sit in on transformation steering committees, ride along with SI delivery teams, and bring the texture of the work back to engineering and design.


* Drive 0→1 and 1→N in parallel. Take new concepts from problem definition through alpha, beta, and GA while continuing to harden what's already in production at Fortune 500 customers.


* Partner deeply with engineering. Work with engineering scrums to prioritise sprints, groom stories, and make sharp trade\-offs across scope, quality, and time. Translate ambiguous customer signals into crisp product specs.


* Shape the Agentic experience. Define how Transformation Agents, the Living Context Graph, and Playbooks come together for executives, PMO leaders, and OCM teams.


* Define and own metrics. Instrument the product, set the bar for adoption and outcomes, and use data to refine the roadmap.


* Be a voice of the company externally. Write blogs, present at customer briefings and partner events, and help shape how the market understands the category we're building.


 Requirements
   

  

* 5\-7 years in product management, with meaningful time at enterprise B2B SaaS companies. Bonus if you've worked on AI/ML and agentic systems.


* A track record of owning a product from inception to launch


* Strong technical instincts. You don't need to be an engineer, but you should be able to reason about LLM\-powered features, distributed systems, data pipelines, and integration architectures, and hold your own in technical tradeoff conversations.


* Customer obsession. You discern signal from noise across customer conversations, market feedback, and product telemetry — and you let data refine your intuition rather than replace it.


* Excellent communication. You write clearly, present confidently to executives, and are equally comfortable in a customer war room, a sprint review, and a partner kickoff.


* Bias for action and comfort with ambiguity. Early\-stage pace, continuous iteration, and shipping under uncertainty energize you.


* Lead by example. Humble, low\-ego, intellectually honest, and genuinely curious. You raise the bar for the people around you.



 Even better
   




* Experience building or shipping LLM\- or agent\-powered products in production.


* Background as an engineer, consultant, or transformation practitioner before becoming a PM.


* Familiarity with the enterprise integration landscape (SAP, Jira, ServiceNow, Salesforce, Workday, Azure DevOps, SharePoint).

**Description**
 As a Sr. Product Manager \- High Confidence Supply\-chain at Amazon, you will own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for products that bring determinism in our fulfillment experience, and consequently, shape our concession and returns reduction strategy. You will work backward from customer needs, maneuver operational constraints and tailwinds, define compelling product strategies, and partner with engineering, design, and cross\-functional teams to deliver meaningful outcomes. This role offers the opportunity to tackle ambiguous problems, make high\-judgment decisions, and drive products from concept through launch and beyond across multiple countries — all while operating in an environment that rewards creative thinking and a bias toward experimentation.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Define product vision, strategy, and roadmap by working backward from business and customer needs, using a combination of customer research, benchmarking, on\-ground operational learnings, and data\-driven insights to prioritize investments and make smart trade\-offs.
* Partner with engineering, design, science, and cross\-functional teams to translate product strategy into well\-scoped deliverables, define acceptance criteria, and drive execution from prototype through launch and post\-launch optimization.
* Influence without authority across teams with different priorities, building alignment among stakeholders in engineering, marketing, sales, legal, finance, and operations to deliver cohesive customer experiences.
* Own product performance by defining success criteria and key metrics, analyzing usage data and customer behavior, and iterating rapidly to improve adoption, satisfaction, and business impact.
* Leverage generative AI tools and emerging technologies to accelerate development cycles, generate deeper insights, and identify new opportunities for product innovation.


 A day in the life
   

  

 You start your morning reviewing product metrics and customer feedback, identifying signals that inform your next set of priorities. By mid\-morning, you are in a design review with your engineering and operational partners, debating trade\-offs on a new feature and for running existing ones. After lunch, you lead a cross\-functional alignment meeting to resolve dependencies with a partner team. Later, you draft a product narrative for an upcoming initiative, grounding your recommendations in customer research and data. Throughout it all, you balance strategic thinking with hands\-on execution.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with end to end product delivery
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience as a product manager or owner
* Experience owning technology products

Summary:

UST is looking for a **Senior Cloud Software Engineer** with expertise in cloud platform engineering, cloud\-native application development, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), automation\-first operations, and AI\-powered CloudOps. The role will be responsible for designing, developing, governing, and optimizing enterprise\-scale AWS and Azure environments while driving intelligent automation, self\-healing operations, and AI\-enabled cloud solutions.


The Opportunity:

As a Senior Cloud Software Engineer, you will play a critical role in building cloud\-native platforms, automation frameworks, AI\-enabled operational tooling, and enterprise\-scale infrastructure solutions. You will collaborate with cross\-functional teams to deliver secure, scalable, resilient, and cost\-efficient cloud services while enabling platform standardization and engineering excellence.


### **Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**


#### **Cloud Software Development**


* Design, develop, test, and maintain cloud\-native services and internal platforms using Python (FastAPI, Django, Flask).
* Build secure, scalable RESTful and event\-driven APIs leveraging Azure and AWS cloud services.
* Develop reusable libraries, frameworks, and shared services to standardize cloud consumption and accelerate delivery.
* Apply clean architecture, SOLID principles, and enterprise design patterns to create resilient and maintainable solutions.
* Design solutions with scalability, observability, security, resilience, and cost optimization as key requirements.
* Develop automation tooling and cloud services supporting large\-scale Azure and AWS environments.

#### **AI, Generative AI \& Agentic Engineering**


* Design and implement AI\-enabled cloud services, intelligent automation solutions, and operational tooling.

* Build and manage CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or GitLab.
* Implement DevSecOps practices including automated scanning, dependency management, and secrets management.
* Enforce engineering standards through code reviews, version control, and automated validation.

#### **Agile Delivery**

* Collaborate with Product Owners, Scrum Masters, architects, and engineering teams.
* Break down platform initiatives into user stories and backlog items with clear acceptance criteria.
* Support continuous improvement and iterative delivery practices.

* Initiate cost control measures by achieving resource efficiency and managing overheads.
* Ability to comprehend and minimize operational risks including wide understanding of audit controls and compliance requirements.

Evidence of good analytical, statistical and data mining skills to study trends and make projections. Production management skills and ability to initiate process improvements and recognize areas for development.

jobs.title: Product Owner II
jobs.description:
Candescent is a forward\-thinking technology company transforming how financial institutions deliver Intelligent Banking experiences. We unite digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions that power and connect digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions—creating seamless engagement across digital, remote, and in\-person channels.
   

  

 Our Experience\-Led, Intelligence\-Driven approach combines human\-centered design with data, automation, and cloud\-based innovation. Built on an API\-first architecture, our extensible ecosystem enables institutions to adapt quickly, integrate easily, and unlock new opportunities for growth—turning every customer interaction into a moment of clarity, confidence, and connection.
   

  

**PRODUCT OWNER**
**Position Summary**
 We are seeking experienced Product Owners to help deliver on our product objectives and roadmaps. Product Owners are responsible for delivering product outcomes and functionality that meet customer and user needs. They translate product vision and insights into prioritized features and user stories, developed by their agile team of 8–10 members.
   

  

 This role collaborates with Candescent clients and Product Managers to identify and prioritize requirements for enhancements to the Banking Platform. Product Owners also work with the Product Advisory Council, participating in user group discussions and presenting both strategic and tactical functionality. Additional responsibilities include release planning, product roadmap maintenance, and backlog grooming for assigned Candescent Banking Services initiatives.
   

  

**Key Areas of Responsibility**
* Lead efforts to define specific functions, integration requirements, user experiences, and deployment strategies for delivery to both the company and market
* Develop, shape, and refine user stories, problem statements, and acceptance criteria to ensure efficient and effective team consumption
* Collaborate with the broader product organization to ensure integration across all Candescent Digital Banking Technology products
* Work closely with the development team to ensure that delivered products meet specified requirements and are delivered on time and within budget
* Drive understanding of the work to be completed by the development team, supporting effective sprint sequencing and incremental delivery
* Participate actively in scrum ceremonies such as sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, daily stand\-ups, and demos
* Maintain functional quality by setting and evaluating expectations and acceptance criteria
* Present and train internal customers on new platform features and services released in each version
* Prepare explanatory documentation for customers on existing and new platform functionality
* Document business requirements using the company's software development tools and methodology


**Product P\&L and Pricing**
* Collaborate with the Product Manager to manage product profitability and performance, ensuring alignment with short\- and long\-term product objectives and roadmaps


**Product Strategy, Vision, and Planning**
* Gather customer and user needs, along with market research, to inform the product vision and strategy created by the Product Manager
* Use the product vision and insights to define product features and prioritize the team’s backlog


**Customer Experience Research, Insights, And Execution**
* Demonstrate a deep understanding of customers and users through the development of insights, including personas, journey maps, and product charters


**Product Design and Development**
* Participate in PI (Program Increment) planning to prioritize the roadmap and inform team backlogs
* Write and prioritize user stories based on business needs, user requirements, and technical feasibility
* Continuously refine the product backlog by analyzing value versus effort
* Define acceptance criteria and validate that features and stories meet user quality standards
* Drive product development in collaboration with cross\-functional teams and engage stakeholders (e.g., PMs, other POs, functions) to manage dependencies and resolve issues


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent work experience
* 5\+ years of experience in the finance industry, preferably with large\-scale digital, online, or mobile banking applications for consumers or small businesses
* Strong understanding of complex business and technical problems
* Proven experience delivering software products through the definition, design, and release cycle
* Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies throughout the software development lifecycle
* Familiarity with industry standards such as PCI, WCAG, and FFIEC
* Strong leadership, project management, time management, and problem\-solving skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Deep understanding of user and business needs to create and prioritize user stories that deliver value
* Ability to prioritize based on business value, user impact, and technical feasibility


**Statement to Third Party Agencies**
 To ALL recruitment agencies: Candescent only accepts resumes from agencies on the preferred supplier list. Please do not forward resumes to our applicant tracking system, Candescent employees, or any Candescent facility. Candescent is not responsible for any fees or charges associated with unsolicited resumes.

A team who is strategic, enabling business acceleration, growth, and success. jobs.description:
**Company Description**
 At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content \- wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Gracenote's Data Platform is the central hub for millions of pieces of TV entertainment data used daily by clients and partners worldwide. It provides the critical services that structure and model data for our editorial, ingest, and delivery systems. This data powers entertainment solutions for the top cable, OTT, CE, and digital clients, reaching hundreds of millions of consumers.
   

  

 We are hiring a lead product manager to own this platform from our Bengaluru engineering center. The role also owns Gracenote's content\-source\-facing products, the Gracenote ID Distribution System (GNIDS) and Gracenote View, through which content owners register content, obtain Gracenote IDs, submit first\-party metadata, and access Gracenote data. This role has a deliberate arc.
   

  

 Initially, this is a hands\-on role. You will write specs and requirements yourself, work directly with engineers and data architects, analyze data with your own queries, and build deep fluency in the platform. We are looking for someone senior who still genuinely enjoys this work.
   

  

 As the platform and your fluency mature, the role expands into a player\-coach position, which will build and mentor a product team in India while remaining close to the platform. Candidates should be excited by both halves of this trajectory, not just the second one.
   

  

 You will be the lead product presence co\-located with our engineering organization, partnering across time zones with Dataset and Delivery Product Managers and commercial stakeholders based in the US and Europe. This is not a satellite role. It is the product anchor for our engineering center.
   

  

 An ideal candidate will have 8\+ years of Product Management experience and a proven track record of end\-to\-end ownership and delivering results.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own the product vision, roadmap, and delivery for Gracenote's Data Platform, the system that structures and models complex TV entertainment data for internal consumers and clients alike.
* Own the Gracenote ID Distribution System (GNIDS) and Gracenote View, including requirements, backlog, delivery, and support for existing customers and partner integrations. Define how these products evolve as the platform matures.
* Work closely with Global Dataset and Delivery Product Managers to understand the business problems in creating and structuring complex entertainment data, and translate those needs into a clear, prioritized roadmap.
* Partner directly with engineering teams and Data Architects to shape data models, write detailed requirements, and drive hands\-on execution, especially in the first phase of the role.
* Define and own the platform's key input and output metrics. Establish platform SLAs and quality measures, and publish them so internal and external consumers can hold the platform accountable.
* Operate effectively across a globally distributed organization: strong async written communication, disciplined documentation, and willingness to flex hours for overlap with US/EU stakeholders.
* Over time, hire, mentor, and grow a high\-performing product team in India while remaining an active individual contributor on the most complex platform problems.


**Qualifications**
* 8\+ years of product management experience, including 3\+ years on platform or data products.
* Demonstrated appetite for hands\-on IC work at a senior level: writing specs, querying data, working directly in the details with engineering.
* Actively uses LLMs in day\-to\-day product work: to accelerate analysis, drive better decisions, automate repetitive PM tasks, and achieve measurable outcomes. Be prepared to walk through concrete examples in the interview.


**Preferred Skills/Experience**
* Experience with TV/entertainment metadata, EPG data, content supply chains, or adjacent media data domains.
* Experience owning client\-facing web applications or APIs alongside a data platform.
* Experience partnering with Data Architects to shape complex business data into coherent, extensible, scalable structures.
* Prior experience as a hiring manager or formal people manager.
* Comfortable with XML, JSON, SQL, and REST APIs; able to write or LLM\-assist your own scripts in Python or SQL to answer product questions.
* Experience working within structured, milestone\-driven development processes and delivering predictably against commitments.
* Highly metrics\-driven: able to distill a complex platform into a small set of key input and output metrics and use them to drive decisions.
* Track record of driving execution rigor in collaboration with cross\-functional teams.
* Excellent verbal and written communication; proven ability to influence stakeholders across geographies and time zones.
* Interest and aptitude for people leadership: prior mentoring, coaching, or team\-lead experience, and genuine motivation to build a team as the role grows.
* Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.


**Additional Information**
 Please be aware that job\-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach …

* Review of monthly Balance Sheet schedules \& reconciliation where required. Liaise with respective stakeholders of Balance Sheet Reconciliations to resolve open items.
* Assist with aspects of financial month end review process:
	+ Manage Operating Expenditure and all reporting requirements (including Operating Expenditure \& Headcount Reporting)

* Perform variance analysis for Balance Sheet, Operating expenses, Margins and Profitability, review financial information against historical run rates and future growth plans.
* Participate \& contribute into business reviews meetings as appropriate.
* Tightly controls transaction activity that operates in line with global processes and incorporates best practice financial controls
* Supporting internal \& external Audit requirements. Ensure compliance with all requirements encompassing data integrity and evidence of process and accuracy.
* Be involved in local and global projects as required.
* Drive Continuous Improvement in the Controllership space and standardization of processes / activities in partnership with the GPO.
